experimental_method: Hydrates formed from gas mixture and water in a 100 cm3 stirred Parr reactor for three days with excess water injected to remove the vapour phase; aqueous phase sampled, flashed to ambient and gas analysed volumetrically and by GC.
quality_remarks: Data are for hydrate-aqueous equilibrium under vapour-unsaturated conditions; authors report C2/C3 concentrations still creeping up at seven days (3-day equilibration a compromise). Data are compared with CSMGem predictions. Footnote letter 'a' printed on T of row 293.15 is probably a typesetting slip for the uncertainty footnote.
